ideas: Cloud-native computing is giving way to AI-native computing
Context density is crucial for AI agents to operate effectively
AI agents require low context density to function properly
Vendors are developing solutions to address context density challenges
Semantic density measures the internal complexity of meaning within a message
Context density measures the meaningful content around a message
items.rating_reason: The article provides a comprehensive overview of the shift from cloud-native to AI-native computing, highlighting the importance of context density in this transition. It offers novel insights into how AI agents require precise, concise context to operate effectively and how various vendors are addressing the challenges of context density. The content is well-researched, and the author's expertise in the field is evident. However, the article could benefit from more concrete examples and a clearer structure to enhance readability.

items.title: Critical Fortinet Forticlient EMS flaw now exploited in attacks
items.summary: FortiClient EMS’s critical SQL injection flaw is actively exploited, and users must upgrade to version 7.4.5 to mitigate it.
ideas: CVE-2026-21643 is a critical SQL injection in FortiClient EMS GUI.
Attackers can inject SQL via the HTTP 'Site' header to execute code.
Over 1,000 FortiClient EMS instances are publicly exposed, many in US and Europe.
Patch by upgrading to FortiClient EMS version 7.4.5 or later.
Fortinet has not yet marked the vulnerability as exploited in official advisories.
Previous FortiClient EMS SQL injection was exploited by state-sponsored groups.
CISA tracks 24 actively exploited Fortinet vulnerabilities, 13 used in ransomware.
items.rating_reason: The article delivers several concrete value instances—new CVE details, exploit method, exposure statistics, patch guidance, and historical context—within a short word count, yielding high value density. It stays focused on cybersecurity without clickbait or padding, though it lacks novel research, keeping it in the good range.
